canonical_title: Hull and main float take-off condition

versions.title_at_revision: Hull and main float take-off condition
versions.text:
For the wing and its attachment to the hull or main float –
(a) The aerodynamic wing lift is assumed to be zero; and
(b) A downward inertia load, corresponding to a load factor computed from the following formula, must be applied: CΤΟ VS12 n = (Tan β)W 2 / 3 1/ 3 where– n = inertia load factor CTO = empirical seaplane operations factor equal to 0·004; VS1 = seaplane stalling speed (knots) at the design take-off weight with the flaps extended in the appropriate take-off position; β = angle of dead rise at the main step (degrees); and W = design water take-off weight in pounds.
